presentation.label: CHORD ARP
presentation.summary: Turn a Digitakt II audio trig into a chord played one note at a time.
presentation.overview: Start with a single note trig and choose a chord shape and note order. The trig's NOTE value can set the root, or you can choose a fixed pitch. Shape the phrase with octave limits, rhythm and groove, then use SPAN or LATCH to play through empty steps.
highlights: Chord extensions from the 7th to the 13th
Thirteen note orders and independent octave limits
Per-trig chord, root and rhythm locks
usage: Place a C5 note trig on step 1 of an audio track. Open SETTINGS, then CHORD ARP.
On Chord, choose MAJ and leave ROOT on TRIG. On Arp, choose UP and 1/16, then turn ARP on.
On Groove, turn SPAN on and press PLAY to hear C, E and G across the empty steps.

steps: Choose CHORD ARP in SETTINGS to open the preview.
Use LEFT and RIGHT to switch pages. Press NO to return.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.
